landing.heroTitleHighlight: take the next step with confidence.
landing.heroDescription: A self-check app to help you access emergency contraception. Anonymous, quick, and shows you what to do next.
landing.anonymousDesc: No personal information required. Everything stays on your device to protect your privacy.
landing.quickDesc: Answer simple questions to find out your next steps immediately.
landing.pharmacyDesc: Find nearby pharmacies based on the official government list.
landing.pdfDesc: Generate a PDF to show at the pharmacy for smooth service.
landing.step1Desc: Follow the on-screen instructions and answer simple questions.
landing.step2Desc: See your recommended next steps based on your situation.
landing.step3Desc: Show your PDF for a smooth consultation.
landing.privacyDesc: No registration required. All information is processed only on your device and is not sent to any external server.
landing.faq1A: Anyone considering emergency contraception can use this app. There are no age restrictions, but minors may want to consult with a guardian or healthcare provider.
landing.faq2A: Yes. No registration is required, and all information is processed only on your device. No data is sent to servers.
landing.faq3Q: Where can I get emergency contraception?
landing.faq3A: Since 2024, some pharmacies in Japan can sell it without a prescription. This app helps you find participating pharmacies. Some situations may require a clinic visit.
landing.faq4A: This app is free. Emergency contraception costs vary by pharmacy/clinic (approximately ¥7,000-¥15,000).
landing.faq5Q: Is this app's result medical advice?
landing.faq5A: No. The results are for reference only and are not a substitute for medical care. Please consult a healthcare professional for final decisions.
landing.finalCtaDesc: Find out your next steps based on your situation
landing.partnerDesc: Rescue Pill is looking for corporate partners, sponsors, and NPO collaborations.
landing.disclaimer: This service is not a substitute for medical care. Please consult a healthcare professional about emergency contraception.

consent.text1: To use this app, you must agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
consent.text2: All information entered is processed only on your device and is not sent to external servers.
consent.item1Title: Not a substitute for medical care
consent.item1Body: This is an information tool for organizing actions, not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment by a doctor or pharmacist.
consent.item2Body: If symptoms are severe or urgent, please visit a medical facility immediately.
consent.item3Body: Input content is temporarily stored in your browser. No data is sent to servers.
consent.item4Body: Assessment is based on rule-based logic. It does not replace the judgment of healthcare professionals.
consent.item5Body: Location information may be used to search for nearby facilities.
